prompt: Create a premium but simple high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE MOCKUP for Fresh Me Up Barbershop, Plano Texas. Edge to edge landscape 1536x1024 with no browser or device frame. Palette only black white neutral gray. Bold condensed sans display and neutral sans UI, nothing serif. Main composition is one immense hollow white HEXAGON FRAME cropped off the right and bottom edges of a black first viewport; this angular geometric frame is a memorable piece of the interface, not a photograph, no bevel or 3D. Keep all content readable inside/along its flat space. Header narrow black with small FRESH ME UP wordmark at left and Services, Find us plus white 'Book on Booksy' button top right. Large heading 'LOOK\nFRESH.' sits at x100 y210, white condensed bold type around 112px; supporting copy 'Haircuts and beard work in Plano.' then clear white rectangular 'Book on Booksy' button left below. Inside the hexagon, at right, a compact typeset service index 'Haircut $30 / Haircut + beard $40 / Beard trim + lineup $25', no service cards and no photos. At base, subdued address text '1861 N Central Expy, Suite 200'. Below black opening region begins a full white location-and-details band: 'COME THROUGH.' big black left and readable 'Plano, TX 75075 / (469) 367-0013 / Get directions' right. Hexagon carries page composition; other regions stay quiet. Avoid all gradients, invented claims or reviews, honeycomb wallpaper, eyebrow labels and decorative section numbers. Real web layout with actual navigation, booking, business identity, and lower-page continuation.
name: The hex frame
